steps.en: Install the extension from the Chrome, Edge or Firefox store
steps.zh: 从 Chrome、Edge 或 Firefox 商店装上扩展

steps.en: Set your target language and level; optionally add an AI provider key
steps.zh: 设好目标语言和水平，按需加一个 AI 服务商 key

steps.en: On a foreign-language page, click the floating button
steps.zh: 打开外文网页，点一下悬浮按钮

steps.en: Picks the page's paragraphs and queues them in batches to the chosen provider
steps.zh: 挑出页面段落，分批排队发给选定的服务商

steps.en: Shows each translation under its original paragraph (bilingual mode)
steps.zh: 把译文显示在每段原文下方（双语模式）

value.en: You read the original with a translation beside it, and can select any phrase to translate, explain or hear it
value.zh: 对照着原文读译文，遇到不懂的词句还能划选翻译、讲解或朗读

sources: https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog#-bilingual--translation-only and #-batch-requests and #-selection-translation (bilingual mode, batching, Translate / Explain / Speak toolbar)

https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/blob/main/src/utils/constants/config.ts (DEFAULT_CONFIG: language.level, pageTranslation.providerId = Microsoft, mode "bilingual", requestQueueConfig, batchQueueConfig, floatingButton.clickAction "translate")
